title: TypographyProjectUseCases
description: Comprehensive project situation ontologies, platform rendering requirements, performance budgets, and typography recommendations.

expensive.name: Expensive / High-End Prestige

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Refined light to medium headlines with wide tracking; crisp neutral body.

expensive.why_it_works: Luxury and expense in typography are communicated through optical tension, disciplined restraint, high stroke contrast (Didone serifs or sculpted display sans), and generous letter-spacing on all-caps titles. Avoids generic corporate defaults in favor of bespoke typographic craft.

premium.name: Premium / Enterprise Excellence

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: SemiBold 600 headlines paired with Regular 400 body.

premium.why_it_works: Premium typography signals stability, precision, and investment. Characterized by balanced x-heights, flawless subpixel curves, multi-weight superfamily depth, and true companion italics.

clean.name: Clean / Frictionless Clarity

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Bold 700 headlines against clean Regular 400 body; generous whitespace.

clean.why_it_works: Cleanliness arises from unadorned terminal geometry, open apertures, consistent stroke widths, and generous line-heights (1.6+), reducing visual noise to zero.

modern.name: Modern / Contemporary Digital

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Variable weight axes, contemporary circular geometry, tight headline tracking.

modern.why_it_works: Modern typography celebrates contemporary digital geometry, variable font axes, and crisp rendering across high-DPI viewports.

elegant.name: Elegant / Refined Grace

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Medium 500 or Light 300 headlines with generous breathing room.

elegant.why_it_works: Elegance balances organic warmth with structural dignity: rhythmic italic cadences, graceful calligraphic terminals, and measured proportions.

editorial.name: Editorial / Literary Authority

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: ExtraBold 800 titles into classical serif body; small sans metadata annotations.

editorial.why_it_works: Draws on centuries of print publishing mastery: clear distinction between editorial voice (serif text) and navigational apparatus (sans metadata).

futuristic.name: Futuristic / Speculative Tech

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Curvilinear techno titles, monospaced telemetry figures, neutral UI.

futuristic.why_it_works: Evokes sci-fi HUDs, aerospace telemetry, and cyberpunk aesthetics through angular geometry, flat horizontal crossbars, and technical monospaced telemetry.

playful.name: Playful / Approachable Warmth

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Soft rounded titles with clean geometric body text.

playful.why_it_works: Softens the interface with organic curve terminals, bouncy baselines, and human warmth, while maintaining accessible body readability.

professional.name: Professional / Institutional Trust

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: SemiBold 600 headlines, Regular 400 text, Medium 500 data tables.

professional.why_it_works: Establishes immediate legal, financial, or corporate credibility through rock-solid proportions, high legibility ratings, and clear numerical figures.

not AI-looking.name: Not AI-Looking / Bespoke Human Craft

typographic_profile.weight_strategy: Bold deliberate weight delta (300+ units), distinctive font alternates, calibrated tracking.

not AI-looking.why_it_works: Eliminates the generic, homogenized 'AI look' (such as default Inter or Roboto set at flat 400 weight with zero personality). Replaces it with authentic typographic tension: pairing distinctive character-rich display cuts (e.g. Ithaca, Chillax, Reckoner, Credit Valley) with purposeful optical tracking and calibrated type scales.

saas.name: Modern SaaS Application
saas.description: High-velocity web software requiring clear feature marketing, user onboarding, and dense application dashboard interfaces.
saas.primary_intent: Product marketing conversion paired with functional application clarity.

landing-page.name: High-Conversion Landing Page
landing-page.description: Marketing landing page focused on bold value propositions, punchy hero headlines, and clear visual calls to action.
landing-page.primary_intent: Immediate visual impact, brand distinction, and scannable benefits.

portfolio.name: Creative & Designer Portfolio
portfolio.description: Showcase for designers, architects, photographers, and creative technologists where typography itself reflects artistic discernment.
portfolio.primary_intent: Unmistakable aesthetic individuality and sophisticated visual voice.

dashboard.name: Data-Heavy Analytics Dashboard
dashboard.description: Dense enterprise and analytics portals displaying complex charts, metrics, tabular data, and status indicators.
dashboard.primary_intent: Rapid data parsing, zero numeral ambiguity, and compact UI legibility.

ecommerce.name: E-Commerce & Digital Storefront
ecommerce.description: Online retail platform balancing engaging brand presentation with clear product pricing and seamless checkout flow.
ecommerce.primary_intent: Brand desire creation combined with trustworthy transaction readability.

fashion.name: High Fashion & Apparel Brand
fashion.description: Editorial storefront and lookbooks for luxury apparel, haute couture, and avant-garde streetwear.
fashion.primary_intent: Elegance, trend-setting visual tension, and artistic poise.

luxury.name: Ultra-Luxury & High Horlogerie
luxury.description: Private wealth, bespoke jewelry, fine watches, and prestigious heritage estates.
luxury.primary_intent: Uncompromised prestige, exclusivity, and classical perfection.

restaurant.name: Gastronomy, Bistro & Fine Dining
restaurant.description: Restaurant menu showcases, culinary storytelling, and reservation experiences.
restaurant.primary_intent: Appetite appeal, sensory atmosphere, and legible menu pricing.

finance.name: Banking & Institutional Finance
finance.description: Traditional banking, asset management, and legal fiduciary portals.
finance.primary_intent: Rock-solid security, established credibility, and clarity.

fintech.name: Modern Fintech & Neobanking
fintech.description: Next-generation financial apps, investment dashboards, and borderless payment platforms.
fintech.primary_intent: Digital speed, trust, and sharp modern sophistication.

crypto.name: Web3, Blockchain & Crypto Exchange
crypto.description: Decentralized finance protocols, token analytics, and Web3 community hubs.
crypto.primary_intent: Cutting-edge decentralization aesthetic with rapid token data readability.

education.name: EdTech, Universities & E-Learning
education.description: Learning management platforms, course libraries, and academic research repositories.
education.primary_intent: Effortless multi-hour reading comfort and cognitive accessibility.

gaming.name: Esports, Game Portals & Gaming UI
gaming.description: Gaming studios, esports leagues, streaming platforms, and game inventory interfaces.
gaming.primary_intent: Adrenaline-fueled theme immersion with rapid telemetry scanning.

news.name: Digital Journalism & News Media
news.description: High-volume news outlets, investigative journalism, and breaking updates.
news.primary_intent: Immediate front-page impact paired with tireless long-form reading stamina.

blog.name: Editorial Blog & Thought Leadership
blog.description: Personal publications, essay series, and tech/design blogs.
blog.primary_intent: Fluid reading flow, distinctive authorial voice, and elegant typographic hierarchy.

agency.name: Design & Digital Agency
agency.description: Creative agencies, branding studios, and boutique consultancies.
agency.primary_intent: Fearless design authority, bold art direction, and confident presentation.

mobile.name: Native Mobile Application (General)
mobile.description: General native iOS/Android utility or productivity apps with small touch targets.
mobile.primary_intent: Compact screen legibility, high pixel density clarity, and smooth 60fps rendering.

platform_performance.notes: Prefer TrueType (.ttf) outlines with clear bytecode hinting for subpixel rasterization on varied Android screens.

flutter.name: Flutter Cross-Platform App
flutter.description: Multi-platform Flutter applications rendered via Impeller or Skia graphics engines.
flutter.primary_intent: Consistent cross-platform font metrics and identical baseline rendering on iOS, Android, and Web.

platform_performance.notes: Define fonts explicitly in pubspec.yaml with matching weight integers (w400, w600, w700).

react-native.name: React Native Application
react-native.description: Cross-platform React Native apps relying on native iOS and Android text renderers.
react-native.primary_intent: Seamless native font linkage, predictable font-weight mapping, and zero layout shift.

platform_performance.notes: Ensure PostScript font names match file naming strictly to prevent Android fontWeight crashes.

android.name: Native Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose)
android.description: Native Android applications conforming to Material Design 3 guidelines.
android.primary_intent: Clear rendering across thousands of varied OEM display matrices and display scales.

platform_performance.notes: Place TTF binaries in res/font/ and reference via FontFamily. Downloadable font providers supported.

ios.name: Native iOS (Swift / SwiftUI)
ios.description: Apple ecosystem apps conforming to Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Dynamic Type.
ios.primary_intent: Crisp Retina subpixel antialiasing and automatic Dynamic Type scaling.

platform_performance.notes: Register in Info.plist under UIAppFonts. PostScript CFF outlines (.otf) render beautifully on CoreText.

powerpoint.name: Microsoft PowerPoint Presentation
powerpoint.description: Corporate slides, executive keynotes, and sales pitch decks.
powerpoint.primary_intent: Auditorium projection legibility, high contrast, and 100% font embedding without font-swap errors on client PCs.

platform_performance.notes: CRITICAL: Microsoft PowerPoint on Windows has severe bugs with OpenType PostScript (.otf) fonts. Always use TrueType (.ttf) files to ensure font embedding succeeds.

presentation.name: Executive Pitch Deck & Keynote
presentation.description: High-stakes venture capital pitches, product reveal keynotes, and conference talks.
presentation.primary_intent: Monumental slide headers that command the stage, with minimal, impactful bullet points.

platform_performance.notes: Keep slide headlines large (36pt–60pt). Test contrast in both 16:9 widescreen and projection lighting.

word.name: Microsoft Word Document
word.description: Business contracts, legal proposals, policy memos, and institutional whitepapers.
word.primary_intent: Dense tabular layout stability, print fidelity, and universal client PC compatibility.

platform_performance.notes: Use TrueType (.ttf) format to prevent Word from converting missing weights into synthetic bold/italics.

pdf.name: PDF Export & Whitepaper
pdf.description: Self-contained downloadable whitepapers, annual reports, and technical manuals.
pdf.primary_intent: Exact vector outline preservation and subset embedding across all desktop/mobile PDF readers.

platform_performance.notes: Verify license allows font subsetting (fsType not 0x0100).

resume.name: Executive & Professional Resume / CV
resume.description: Single or two-page professional curriculum vitae read by recruiters and automated Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
resume.primary_intent: Instant optical scannability, compact information density, and polished professionalism.

platform_performance.notes: Maintain 10pt–11pt body text with 1.3–1.4 line-height for optimal page density and ATS text extraction.

poster.name: Event, Festival & Exhibition Poster
poster.description: Large-format print and digital posters viewed from a distance of several feet.
poster.primary_intent: Distant visual capture, overwhelming graphic personality, and distinct hierarchy.

platform_performance.notes: PostScript outlines (.otf) deliver supreme Bézier curve accuracy when scaled to 300DPI large format printing.

logo.name: Logotype & Brand Wordmark
logo.description: Foundational brand logotypes and product wordmarks.
logo.primary_intent: Unique silhouette recognition, timeless trademark distinctiveness, and reduction clarity at favicon sizes.

platform_performance.notes: Convert typography to vector outlines (SVG) in production brand marks.

branding.name: Comprehensive Brand Identity System
branding.description: Holistic brand guidelines spanning packaging, stationery, website, social assets, and corporate collateral.
branding.primary_intent: Cohesive brand voice across both digital and physical touchpoints.

platform_performance.notes: Select superfamilies with complete desktop (OTF/TTF) and webfont (WOFF2) licenses.

advertisement.name: Digital Ad & Billboard Campaign
advertisement.description: Social media display ads, web banners (IAB standard sizes), and outdoor digital billboards.
advertisement.primary_intent: Sub-second visual hook, punchy copy delivery, and instant brand recall.

platform_performance.notes: Ad networks impose strict asset payload limits (< 150KB total for the entire banner zip).
